title: TUI: ratatui-textarea widget for title/description editing
description:
Adopt ratatui-textarea 0.9.2 (crates.io, ratatui org fork of rhysd/tui-textarea, MIT) for the TUI edit pane's typed fields (Title, Description), replacing the hand-rolled EditBuffer in src/tui.rs (from cb08a6e4).

Decided over tui-widgets 0.7.11 / tui-prompts 0.6.7: TextState is single-line only ("TODO handle multi-line input"), with no selection, yank, or undo. ratatui-textarea provides multi-line editing, cursor movement (arrows, word moves, Home/End, PageUp/Down), insert, delete (Backspace/Delete, word/line kills), selection + copy/cut/paste via its internal yank buffer, undo/redo, soft wrapping, placeholder/mask, and a crossterm backend (ratatui-crossterm). Version fit: pebbles' ratatui 0.30.2 resolves ratatui-core 0.1.2 + ratatui-widgets 0.3.2, within ratatui-textarea's bounds (ratatui-core 0.1.1, ratatui-widgets 0.3.1); pin exactly (=0.9.2, pinned-exact policy).

Requirements:
- Keep the existing edit-pane key UX (r[tui-edit]): Enter arms editing; Title applies on Enter; Description Enter inserts a newline and Tab applies; Esc cancels without writing; empty-title validation surfaces in the message line with the pane open; cycled Type/Status fields keep the commit-and-stay behavior (pebble 2931fdf7 regression: first Enter must not blank other fields).
- Cursor movement: Left/Right/Up/Down and Home/End at least (word moves desirable), cursor visible in the pane.
- Delete: Backspace and Delete at the cursor.
- Copy & paste: selection (Shift+arrows or similar), copy and cut into the widget yank buffer, paste from it. Exact key map documented in the pane hint, README, and SPEC.
- Commit path unchanged: apply runs the update operation (title/description), keeping validation and commit-per-operation jj integration.

Testing:
- Unit tests for the binding layer using TextArea state methods (existing test style).
- Termlens e2e in tests/tui_e2e.rs (dev-dep from d5b52cd6): drive the real binary in a PTY and assert cursor movement, insert, delete, and copy/paste against the rendered screen AND the resulting issue file after apply. Rows: type into Title, move cursor, Backspace/Delete, select+copy a span, move, paste, Tab/Enter apply, Esc cancel writes nothing, multi-line Description paste.
- Update SPEC r[tui-edit] and the TUI help text to the new key map.

Related: cb08a6e4 (inline edit pane), 2931fdf7 (first-Enter UX), d5b52cd6 (termlens adoption), ea0091cd (tui-tree-widget eval, the other widget eval).
